reviews.text: I’ve tried many skincare products, but this one has become one of my favorites. It has a gentle formula, doesn’t irritate my skin, and provides long-lasting hydration. After a few weeks of use, my skin looks brighter, smoother, and more balanced. I would buy it again.
reviews.zh: 用過好多護膚品，但呢款已經成為我最愛之一。配方溫和，唔會刺激到我塊面，仲有持久嘅保濕效果。用咗幾個星期之後，皮膚望落更亮、更滑、更加平衡。我會再買。

reviews.text:
2) SKIN1004 Centella Ampoule Foam — Review
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ 5/5
Such a gentle but effective cleanser! It foams nicely, cleans the skin well and removes sunscreen without making my face feel tight or dry. My skin feels soft and calm after washing, and it’s great even for sensitive areas. The formula feels soothing and not irritating at all. A little goes a long way, so the bottle lasts long.
Best for: everyday morning & evening cleanse ✅
reviews.zh:
2) SKIN1004 Centella Ampoule Foam — 評價
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ 5/5
好溫和但有效嘅潔面！起泡效果好好，洗得乾淨，去得到防曬，唔會令塊面覺得繃緊或者乾。洗完之後皮膚軟軟哋、好舒服，就連敏感肌位都用得。配方舒緩，完全唔刺激。少量已經好夠用，所以支嘢都好襟用。
最適合：每日早晚清潔 ✅

reviews.text:
The Perfect pH-Balanced Finish for Double Cleansing
​"If the cleansing oil is the 'heavy duty' solvent for sunscreen and sebum, then this Centella Ampoule Foam is the precision finish. As an engineer who monitors my skin’s condition closely, I know that the biggest risk with foam cleansers is stripping the moisture barrier (that 'squeaky clean' feeling is actually bad news). This product, however, strikes the perfect balance between cleaning power and hydration.
​
reviews.zh:
雙重清潔嘅完美 pH 平衡收結
「如果話卸妝油係對付防曬同油脂嘅『重型溶劑』，咁呢支 Centella Ampoule Foam 就係精準嘅收結。作為一個密切留意自己皮膚狀況嘅工程師，我知泡沫潔面最大嘅風險就係洗走皮膚嘅保濕屏障（嗰種『吱吱聲』嘅乾淨感其實係壞消息）。不過呢款產品喺清潔力同保濕之間做到完美平衡。」

reviews.text: Unfortunately, this cleanser did not work for me. I’m not sure what changed, because I had bought this exact same cleanser before and loved it! The first time I bought it, it cleansed my skin well and wasn’t irritating. This time, it REALLY irritated my skin and caused it to sting!😭🥺 I was so surprised because it had never done that previously. So, I’m not sure if they added some exfoliants to the formulation or something, but I’ve used my tube of it about 3 times and its just been sitting in my shower since😢🙂‍↕️ It was really a disappointment. It also seemed way more drying this time as well. I can’t say that I recommend it anymore, regrettably.
reviews.zh: 可惜呢款潔面唔啱我用。我唔知有咩變咗，因為之前我買過同一款，而且好鍾意！第一次買嘅時候洗得乾淨又唔刺激。呢次真係非常刺激我塊面，搞到好似拮拮地咁！😭🥺 因為之前從來未試過咁，所以我好驚訝。唔知係咪佢哋加咗去角質成分定係其他嘢，我用咗大概 3 次之後，支嘢就一直擺喺浴室😢🙂‍↕️ 真係好失望。而且今次用落亦感覺更加乾。遺憾嘅係，我冇辦法再推薦呢款產品。

reviews.text: Very nice soft foam for washing. Soothes skin irritations, has a light soapy smell. Also brightens my post acne skin. It cleanses well and there is not much of a tight feeling on my skin afterwards. The photo shows the product consumption per month if used every day.
reviews.zh: 好綿軟嘅泡沫，用嚟洗面好舒服。可以舒緩皮膚刺激，有陣淡淡嘅皂香。仲可以提亮我爆完瘡之後嘅皮膚。洗得好乾淨，洗完之後皮膚都唔會覺得點繃緊。相入面係每日用嘅話，每個月大概用嘅份量。

reviews.text: The item came packaged wrapped in layers of bubble wrap for security, especially for international shipping to the United States. The item along with the rest of my order came within a week of ordering, which I was able to track its process and then location with the Track Order tab on the website and app. (Side note, if you download the app, allow notifications and sign in with an account you are able to receive 5.00p which can be transferred into 5.00 US dollars, to which you can choose to use on any order.) I have used the cleanser for a while now and I have to say it doesn’t irritate my sensitive skin.
reviews.zh: 貨品用咗幾層泡泡紙包好，保障運送安全，特別係寄去美國嘅國際速遞。連埋訂單其他嘢一齊，一個星期內到貨，我可以用網站同 app 上面嘅「Track Order」分頁追蹤運送過程同位置。（題外話，如果你下載 app、開放通知同登入帳戶，可以收到 5.00p，可以轉做 5.00 美金，用喺任何訂單都得。）我已經用咗呢款潔面一段時間，敏感肌嘅我完全冇被刺激到。

reviews.text: I usually suffer from white heads all the time. No matter how many cleanups are done at the salon, they reappear within 3 days. After using this product for two days after the cleansing oil, my skin is really clear. No whiteheads appeared again. Ordered for the 02nd set today. Used the foam in the morning as well without the oil.
reviews.zh: 我成日都生白頭粉刺，無論去 salon 清幾多次，3 日內就會再翻發。用咗卸妝油再用呢款產品兩日之後，皮膚真係清晒，冇再出白頭。即日已經落咗第 2 set 嘅單。朝早我自己冇用卸妝油，直接用泡沫潔面。

reviews.text: The SILKIEST, luxurious textured foam! A little goes a looong way, like a chickpea sized amount will lather enough to wash your entire upper body. No scent, pH 5.5, moist finish. The moist finish is where I think it goes wrong for me because I think it might contribute to clogging my pores, but my skin already gets gunky on its own. It didn't help.
reviews.zh: 絲滑到爆、好有奢華感嘅質地嘅泡沫！少量已經用好耐，大概鷹嘴豆咁大嘅份量就可以起泡洗完整個上身。冇香味，pH 5.5，沖完有保濕感。個保濕感就係我覺得呢款唔啱我嘅地方，因為我覺得佢可能會塞毛孔，但我本身皮膚就已經容易積聚污垢，所以對我嚟講冇幫助。
